adjudication.rationale: Diff shows `CalendarManager.createEvent` now returns `externalId` only from its new optional param, and `EventManager` now persists `externalCalendarId` from `result.externalId` (e.g., `externalCalendarId: isCalendarType ? result.externalId : undefined`). In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the credential-less fan-out path (`destination.credentialId` falsy) calls `createEvent(c, event)` without the `externalId` argument, so `result.externalId` will be `undefined`. This means BookingReference rows created via that path will have `externalCalendarId` unset (where previously it was taken from `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`), which can break later update/delete operations that rely on `reference.externalCalendarId`.
